## Highlights

- **DashX360-style Metro console** — enable in Settings → **Beta Metro Console**
- **Home hub** — Last played, Favorite, Most played, and Game List tiles
- **Search channel** — search your library with controller/keyboard support
- **Settings blade** — 4×2 green tile grid (System, Preferences, Profile, Kinect, etc.)
- **Boot video** — DashX360 boot screen when entering console mode
- **Tab slide animations** — full left/right slide between search / home / games / settings
- **Dashboard sounds** — Page Left / Page Right on tab changes
- **Favorite (X)** — pin games from hub, library, and game options
- **Profile editor** — Xbox 360 blade-style overlay with controller support

## Download

Install **X360-Manager-Setup-1.6.4.exe** (Windows 10/11, 64-bit).

## Setup

1. Enable **Beta Metro Console** in App Settings
2. Open **Console Mode** from the game library
3. Use **LB / RB** for tabs; **X** to favorite; **Y** for options

## Changes since v1.6.3

- Metro dashboard: search, home, games, settings channels
- Home hub (game list, last played, favorite, most played)
- Boot video + startup sound on console entry
- Tab slide animation with background parallax
- Search Backspace/Delete fix
- Page Left/Right sounds on tab navigation
- Light theme readability improvements across the desktop UI
